recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce Observation.focalPoint/focalSubject or restore 0..1 cardinality under this issue; reconcile any future subject target-profile or focus-example changes under their own Jira keys.
issue_request: FHIR-14863 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and requested an Observation focal point for observations about something associated with the patient but more specific than the patient or a body site. The accepted resolution promoted the focal-subject extension to a core DSTU element with Reference(Any) and requested cautionary guidance against using Observation when a more specific resource fits.
initial_application: Historical source commits d06b52856c89401a981241a811faa7b455037c08 and 5c093b94a97c0320ee01c1ec9914fd824433ba4e added the focal-subject/focus material and renamed Observation.focalSubject to Observation.focus under GF#14863 and the same issue family.
additional_context: The linked Zulip discussion confirms the work group chose an inline focus element with boundary text instead of broadening Observation.subject to Reference(Any). Later FHIR-15825 deliberately changed Observation.focus cardinality from 0..1 to 0..*, and later clarification work refined subject/focus guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active Observation StructureDefinition defines Observation.focus as 0..* Reference(Resource), the current representation of Reference(Any), and the narrative already contains the requested Observation boundary guidance.
